# 4News

4News is a minimal, objective, AI-powered Australian news briefing site at https://4news.com.au/.

The site rewrites and summarises public-source Australian news into concise multi-source briefs. It links to original sources for verification and may include source-difference notes, public social discussion links, public-figure context, and optional 4News commentary. 4News is a briefing layer and does not claim first-party reporting.

## Primary pages

- Home: https://4news.com.au/
- About: https://4news.com.au/about.html
- Editorial policy: https://4news.com.au/editorial-policy.html
- Corrections: https://4news.com.au/corrections.html
- Privacy: https://4news.com.au/privacy.html
- Terms: https://4news.com.au/terms.html

## Machine-readable news data

- English: https://4news.com.au/news.en.json
- Simplified Chinese: https://4news.com.au/news.zh-Hans.json
- Traditional Chinese: https://4news.com.au/news.zh-Hant.json
- Sinhala: https://4news.com.au/news.si.json
- Japanese: https://4news.com.au/news.ja.json
- Korean: https://4news.com.au/news.ko.json
- Vietnamese: https://4news.com.au/news.vi.json
- Thai: https://4news.com.au/news.th.json
- Spanish: https://4news.com.au/news.es.json

## Content principles

- 4News does not copy full news articles, images, video, audio, or publisher logos.
- Original source links should be used for full context.
- AI-generated briefs may contain errors and should be checked against original sources.
- Public-figure context is limited to news-relevant public figures. Private individuals, victims, minors, and ordinary witnesses should not be amplified.
